language/kahu-tok.name: tonal tense
language/kahu-tok.summary: the system of marking time in kahu-tok by tone. a level tone is present, a rising tone is future, a falling tone is past. the same base verb carries all three.

language/kahu.name: age of tapestry
language/kahu.summary: the founding era of the kahu civilization. the great coalescence. four hundred years of language-building, institution-building, and the messenger missions that drew distant survivors to tora vyl drak.
